svg.title: SURMOUNT-1: share of participants reaching each weight-loss threshold at week 72, tirzepatide 15 mg vs placebo
svg.desc: Treatment-regimen estimand. At least 5%: 90.9% vs 34.5%. At least 10%: 83.5% vs 18.8%. At least 15%: 70.6% vs 8.8%. At least 20%: 56.7% vs 3.1%. Source: Jastreboff et al., NEJM 2022, Table 2.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
